U_calibration.rule: Proposed normalization from destination-service prices, with a scoped original pressure-procurement cross-check. The manufacturing basket assumes a common Earth-delivery scope that the previous U quote did not establish, and is not an independent calibration. No market exchange rate, peg or universal relative-price consistency is established; rescaling units cannot finance a deficit.

limits: Diameters are catalogue parameters; no uniform measurement accuracy or error propagation is claimed.
Missing diameters remain unknown; no albedo-based diameter is silently substituted.
A uniform density and spherical volume give scenario masses, not measured masses.
Darkness and this orbit filter establish neither water grade nor the assumed transport delta-v.
Excluded names illustrate science/heritage screening; all other bodies remain unapproved.
Known-body stock is incomplete and is not a million-year population forecast; dynamical replenishment must not be treated as an inexhaustible local reserve.

rules: Receipts from Earth require independent external buyers; internal supplier sales, residents spending U, taxes, borrowing and equity are not additional consolidated earned revenue.
Operating balance is the external cash position of the whole modeled society, not corporate profit or GDP. Domestic wages and retained domestic replacement work are internal.
New commercial facilities and ordinary imported materials are explicit. Existing post-construction capacity may be used only within rated throughput, preserving the separate 25 percent spare margin.
Manufacturing and computing activities are suppressed if their incremental external costs, renewal and resource provision exceed receipts; rejected demand cases remain visible.
The Earth-return service fee covers ground recovery/handling only. Capsules, shields, deorbit fuel and relaunch are priced separately once.
No return spacecraft is assumed empty or to brake for free; outward cargo, fuel backhaul and sale goods share the stated mass and tank limits.
USD inputs are prospective 2026-purchasing-power prices, inflated once; no future vendor quote or million-year economic forecast is asserted.

The proposed 30 USD2041/U normalization is checked against matched destination-service and original pressure-procurement prices. Manufacturing-price comparison is separately hypothetical because the earlier 50 U/kg quote left freight scope unpriced. No currency peg or universal price consistency is adopted.
Resource-transition provision is a stated funding requirement, not a validated depletion valuation or demonstration of adequate million-year sustainability.
Passenger access fares and any unmodelled passenger-carrier surplus are excluded; destination facilities have additional food/life-support provision.
Beyond-local Solar System expansion and its socioeconomic boundary remain unresolved future work.
